text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe fought valiantly in the 
Satsuki Sho... And according to her 
destined Trainer, who praised her great 
effort, they too are "SETO."

The next goal is the Japanese Derby, 
but... Neo Universe made a "future 
prediction" of "rainfall" and a 
"severance" from her Trainer.

Assuming she might not make it to the 
racetrack, she tells her: "Please, make 
sure you come to the Japan Derby."
